# descope_session_settings (Resource)

Manages the project-level session management settings. This is a singleton resource, and its id is always the project ID.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `project_id` (String) The ID of the project that these settings belong to. Changing this value will require the resource to be deleted and recreated.

### Optional

- `access_key_jwt_template` (String) The ID of the JWT template used for access key session tokens.
- `access_key_session_token_expiration` (String) How long access key session tokens remain valid before they expire.
- `enable_inactivity` (Boolean) Whether to detect idle sessions and close them on behalf of the user.
- `inactivity_time` (String) How long a session can be inactive before it's closed, when `enable_inactivity` is set.
- `refresh_token_cookie_domain` (String) The domain the refresh token cookie is restricted to.
- `refresh_token_cookie_policy` (String) The SameSite cookie policy for the refresh token cookie, either `strict`, `lax` or `none`.
- `refresh_token_expiration` (String) How long refresh tokens remain valid before they expire.
- `refresh_token_response_method` (String) How refresh tokens are managed by the Descope SDKs, either `response_body` or `cookies`.
- `refresh_token_rotation` (Boolean) Whether to rotate the refresh token every time it's used to refresh the session.
- `session_token_cookie_domain` (String) The domain the session token cookie is restricted to.
- `session_token_cookie_policy` (String) The SameSite cookie policy for the session token cookie, either `strict`, `lax` or `none`.
- `session_token_expiration` (String) How long session tokens remain valid before they expire.
- `session_token_response_method` (String) How session tokens are managed by the Descope SDKs, either `response_body` or `cookies`.
- `step_up_token_expiration` (String) How long step up tokens remain valid before they expire.
- `trusted_device_token_expiration` (String) How long trusted device tokens remain valid before they expire.
- `user_jwt_template` (String) The ID of the JWT template used for user session tokens (e.g. `descope_jwt_template.example.id`).

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
